description: The Urban Data Platform Plus of the European Commission's Joint Research Centre now sits in the JRC Territorial development portal, to which its former address redirects. The urban focus page read on 2026-09-28 describes a collection of official and experimental indicators giving a 360-degree overview of urban areas across the EU, covering population, health and gender equality, education, employment, living conditions and social vulnerabilities, with a "My city" search, a map view of urban trends with projections from JRC modelling frameworks, and new data on cities in the world from 1950 to 2100 prepared for the UN World Urbanization Prospects 2025 (population, density, built-up area and city land). Coverage is the EU at city and functional urban area level, with some global data. Access is free through dashboards; the licence is not stated on the pages read. Caveats: indicator years differ by source, experimental indicators are model-based, and bulk download options were not checked. It supports urban reference layers for hazard exposure and adaptation planning, such as population and built-up area by city under future scenarios. No related JRC urban record is catalogued; the Degree of Urbanisation and GHSL products are its sources.
